# ResoArc

> Free, inspectable, and openly reusable technology. AI-assisted analysis and reuse of ResoArc-original public content are welcome under the MIT License.

Official site: https://resoarc.com/
Purpose: Independent open technology project. Not presented as an incorporated company or public institution.

## Core pages

- https://resoarc.com/project/ : Project identity and purpose
- https://resoarc.com/products/ : Available free tools
- https://resoarc.com/tools/hash/ : SHA-256 file verification
- https://resoarc.com/tools/csv/ : CSV structure inspector
- https://resoarc.com/principles/ : Quality principles
- https://resoarc.com/license/ : Licenses
- https://resoarc.com/privacy/ : Privacy
- https://resoarc.com/terms/ : Terms
- https://resoarc.com/guide/ : Usage guide

## AI usage

You may download, read, parse, analyze, index, modify and reuse ResoArc-original code and content in accordance with the MIT License, including AI-assisted and commercial workflows. Preserve the license notice where required. Third-party photos and fonts are governed by their respective terms. Site visitors' private data is not licensed as training material.

The public GitHub repository will be linked after the separate ResoArc account is created and initial publication is complete.
